MISSING_SEMICOLON.title: Missing semicolon
MISSING_SEMICOLON.explain: A statement was not terminated with ';' before the next statement began.

MISSING_RPAREN.title: Missing closing parenthesis
MISSING_RPAREN.explain: An opening '(' was never matched by a closing ')'.

MISSING_LPAREN.title: Missing opening parenthesis
MISSING_LPAREN.explain: A ')' appears without its matching '(' - the condition or argument list is not opened.

MISSING_RBRACE.title: Missing closing brace
MISSING_RBRACE.explain: A block was opened with '{' but never closed with '}'.

MISSING_LBRACE.title: Missing opening brace
MISSING_LBRACE.explain: An if/while/else header must be followed by a '{ ... }' block.

MISSPELLED_KEYWORD.title: Misspelled keyword or type
MISSPELLED_KEYWORD.explain: An identifier sits where a C keyword or type name was expected and is within a few edits of one.

TYPO_IDENTIFIER.title: Misspelled variable name
TYPO_IDENTIFIER.explain: The identifier is not declared, but it is a few edits away from a variable that is in scope.

MISSING_DECLARATION.title: Missing declaration
MISSING_DECLARATION.explain: The variable is used but never declared anywhere in the program.

USE_BEFORE_DECLARATION.title: Used before declaration
USE_BEFORE_DECLARATION.explain: The variable is declared later in the same scope - the use comes first.

OUT_OF_SCOPE_USE.title: Used outside its scope
OUT_OF_SCOPE_USE.explain: The variable was declared inside a block (or a for-loop header) that has already ended.

TYPE_MISMATCH.title: Type mismatch
TYPE_MISMATCH.explain: The value's type is incompatible with the variable, operator or condition it is used in.

MISSING_INCLUDE.title: Missing #include
MISSING_INCLUDE.explain: A standard-library function or constant is used, but the header that declares it is not included.

WRONG_ARG_COUNT.title: Wrong number of arguments
WRONG_ARG_COUNT.explain: The call passes more or fewer arguments than the function's declaration accepts.
